evidence.quote: Day-old loaves go to half price at two in the afternoon, not at close.
At close nobody is left to buy them.

observations.why: Generic present-tense statement of an established pricing rule, framed as a general pattern rather than a specific event, so realis and abstract construal.

evidence.quote: the shelf card changes at two as well

observations.why: Describes a planned change at a specific time to a named artifact (shelf card), so future focus on a planned, not yet actual, state.
